title: Design System: El Fortín Riba-roja — The Concierge Desk

scope.note: Option D candidate landing. Promote this file to .impeccable/design.json (and DESIGN-concierge-desk.md to DESIGN.md) only if Option D is chosen. The live site keeps the Pacaso-derived system in DESIGN.md until then.

display.purpose: Hero promise only. Warm white #fbf6ea over the photograph with a 28px text-shadow; two lines at ≥900px.

headline.purpose: One per chapter; text-wrap: balance; 28px before the prose.

title.purpose: Sub-titles within a chapter. Rate-card room titles run 2rem with a 2px ink rule.

figure.purpose: Unit numbers, the 4% guarantee plate (clamp(4rem, 8vw, 6rem), width 84, tracking -0.03em). Narrow Archivo, tabular.

body.purpose: All prose in Libre Caslon Text at a 62ch measure; the manager's letter runs 1.1875rem.

data.purpose: dt/dd rows on board, rate card, team list, fee table. Values 600 right-aligned on paper, 500 on walnut; tabular.

label.purpose: Plate buttons, masthead, tabs, form labels, plaque keys, Sold chip, signature. Uppercase, 0.10–0.14em, width 108–112.

caption.purpose: Figure captions, board notes, hero provenance note, colophon.

shadows.name: engraved-plate
shadows.purpose: Plate buttons at rest. Brass is engraved: highlight top, bevel bottom, short drop.

shadows.name: engraved-plate-active
shadows.purpose: Plate pressed: bevel inverts, drop shortens.

shadows.name: case
shadows.purpose: Recessed wooden cases: the split-flap board (rack uses .06 / .35 / -24px).

shadows.name: object-on-desk
shadows.purpose: Photographs and the listing card (.8) lying on a walnut chapter. Carousel slides use 0 24px 48px -28px rgba(0,0,0,.9).

gradients.name: brass-face
gradients.purpose: Stand-in for engraved brass on tags and the guarantee plate. Not canonised as brass; scheduled for replacement by raster assets.

gradients.name: ledger-rules
gradients.purpose: Ruled lines every 2rem on every ledger chapter.

gradients.name: window-wash
gradients.purpose: Walnut wash over the hero photograph for masthead and headline legibility.

gradients.name: safe-warmth
gradients.purpose: Brass warmth on the green safe (mirrored bottom-left at .14 on the guest book).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing curve. Every transition and keyframe uses it.

motion.name: duration-colour
motion.purpose: Colour-only changes: links, tabs, arrows, input baselines.

motion.name: duration-enter
motion.purpose: Unit detail fade-up (unit-in) and split-flap cell flip.

motion.name: duration-pendulum
motion.purpose: Tag settling back on its hook.

motion.name: keyframes-settle
motion.purpose: Pendulum for a tag returned to the hook.

motion.name: keyframes-flip
motion.purpose: Split-flap value cell; 60ms stagger per cell, perspective 600px.

motion.name: keyframes-unit-in
motion.purpose: Selected unit detail entering the live region.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none; transition-duration: 0.01ms; tag transforms: none; scroll-behavior: auto
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce removes all motion; desk.js also skips settle/flip and uses instant scroll.

breakpoints.name: listing-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Listing card stacks (image 4:3); tab labels compress to 0.75rem / 0.04em.

breakpoints.name: form-single
breakpoints.purpose: Guest-book form goes to one column.

breakpoints.name: plaques-strip
breakpoints.purpose: Plaques become 3-up; masthead subtitle shows once solid.

breakpoints.name: chapter-split
breakpoints.purpose: Two-column chapters; key rack 5→10 columns; figure bleed; carousel basis min(34vw, 460px).

layout.container: none — chapters run edge to edge; the gutter frames

components.name: Plate (primary button)
components.description: Engraved brass plate; the only button style. Large variant on the hero and the form submit.
components.css: .ds-plate { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--brass, #b08d57); color: var(--walnut-deep, #1c130e); font-family: "Archivo", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; font-stretch: 108%; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,244,214,.55), inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(60,40,12,.45), 0 10px 24px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.6); transition: background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-plate:hover { background: var(--brass-light, #d4b57a); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-plate:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 rgba(60,40,12,.45), 0 4px 12px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.6); } .ds-plate:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass-light, #d4b57a); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-plate--lg { min-height: 56px; padding: 0 36px; font-size: 0.9375rem; }

components.name: Arrow (carousel control)
components.description: Square 48px outline control with a stroked chevron; the only non-plate button.
components.html: <button class="ds-arrow" type="button" aria-label="Next photograph"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-arrow { width: 48px; height: 48px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--brass, #b08d57); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--brass-light, #d4b57a); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-arrow:hover { background: var(--brass, #b08d57); color: var(--walnut-deep, #1c130e); } .ds-arrow:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass-light, #d4b57a); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-arrow svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: square; }

components.name: Masthead
components.description: Fixed masthead: uppercase wide Archivo name left, brass-light 'Talk to Uriel' link right; solid walnut-deep with brass hairline once scrolled.
components.html: El Fortín Riba-roja · ValenciaTalk to Uriel
components.css: .ds-masthead { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 18px 32px; color: var(--ledger, #efe6d2); font-family: "Archivo", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-masthead--solid { background: rgba(28,19,14,.94); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(176,141,87,.35); } .ds-masthead__name { color: inherit; font-weight: 600; font-stretch: 112%; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; } .ds-masthead__name span { margin-left: 0.75em; font-weight: 400; font-stretch: 100%; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--paper-on-walnut, #c9ad7f); } .ds-masthead__talk { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: var(--brass-light, #d4b57a); padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--brass, #b08d57); transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-masthead__talk:hover { color: var(--ledger, #efe6d2); } .ds-masthead a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass-light, #d4b57a); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tabs (split-flap board)
components.description: Text tabs on a brass hairline; the selected tab turns ledger and grows a 2px brass underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(176,141,87,.35); background: var(--walnut-deep, #1c130e); padding: 0 8px; } .ds-tab { flex: 1 1 0; position: relative; padding: 10px 6px 12px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--paper-on-walnut, #c9ad7f); font-family: "Archivo", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-tab::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; background: var(--brass, #b08d57); transform: scaleX(0); transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-tab:hover, .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--ledger, #efe6d2); } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"]::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass-light, #d4b57a); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field (baseline input)
components.description: No box: uppercase Archivo label over a Caslon input with a single brass baseline; brass-light on focus, terracotta on error.
components.html: That email address doesn't look complete.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; background: var(--walnut-deep, #1c130e); padding: 16px; } .ds-field label { font-family: "Archivo", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--paper-on-walnut, #c9ad7f); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--brass, #b08d57); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ledger, #efe6d2); font-family: "Libre Caslon Text", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; caret-color: var(--brass, #b08d57); transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: rgba(201,173,127,.85); } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: var(--brass-light, #d4b57a); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--brass-light, #d4b57a); } .ds-field.is-invalid input { border-bottom-color: #d68a6a; } .ds-field__error { margin: 0; font-family: "Archivo", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #e6a68c; }

components.name: Choice (square radio)
components.description: 18px square brass outline; an 8px brass-light square scales in when checked. Option text in Caslon.
components.css: .ds-choice { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--walnut-deep, #1c130e); font-family: "Libre Caslon Text", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--ledger, #efe6d2); cursor: pointer; } .ds-choice input { appearance: none; width: 18px; height: 18px; margin: 0; border: 1px solid var(--brass, #b08d57); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; } .ds-choice input::after { content: ""; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--brass-light, #d4b57a); transform: scale(0); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-choice input:checked::after { transform: scale(1); } .ds-choice input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brass-light, #d4b57a); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Key tag on hook
components.description: Signature: a brass tag hanging from a hook in a recessed walnut cubby. Lifts and rotates on hover; pressed state lifts further and brightens.
components.css: .ds-cubby { position: relative; width: 120px; aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; display: grid; place-items: start center; padding-top: 12%; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1a120d 0%, #201711 60%, #241a13 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 6px 14px -6px rgba(0,0,0,.9), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(176,141,87,.18); overflow: hidden; } .ds-cubby::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 6%; left: 50%; width: 6px; height: 6px; margin-left: -3px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--brass-light, #d4b57a); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.6); } .ds-tag { position: relative; width: 58%; aspect-ratio: 5 / 9; margin-top: 4%; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #d9bc84 0%, var(--brass, #b08d57) 45%, #a3844f 100%); color: var(--walnut-deep, #1c130e); font-family: "Archivo", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; display: grid; place-items: center; align-content: center; gap: 8%; transform-origin: 50% 0%; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,244,214,.65), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(60,40,12,.45), 0 10px 18px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.85); transition: transform 480ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), filter 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-tag__hole { width: 22%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: #1a120d; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.8), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,244,214,.35); } .ds-tag__num { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; font-stretch: 90%; line-height: 1; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,244,214,.5); } .ds-tag:hover, .ds-tag:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-8%) rotate(-4deg); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,244,214,.65), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(60,40,12,.45), 0 22px 26px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.9); outline: none; } .ds-tag[aria-pressed="true"] { transform: translateY(-14%) rotate(3deg); filter: brightness(1.12); }

components.name: Data row (ledger)
components.description: The rate-card row: label in ink-soft, value 600 tabular right-aligned, hairline in ledger-rule, on ruled paper.
components.html:

€190,557
Premium furniture & fit-out package
€15,959.66
Closing costs & taxes
~12% of price, indicative
components.css: .ds-rows { margin: 0; padding: 8px 24px; background-color: var(--ledger, #efe6d2); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 calc(2rem - 1px), rgba(42,31,24,.14) calc(2rem - 1px) 2rem); color: var(--ink, #1e1611); } .ds-rows div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 16px; align-items: baseline; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(42,31,24,.14); font-family: "Archivo", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-rows dt { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft, #6b5744); } .ds-rows dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }

components.name: Plaque strip
components.description: Walnut cells separated by brass hairlines; uppercase key, tabular value, the last value in brass-light.
components.css: .ds-plaques { margin: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1px; background: rgba(176,141,87,.35); } .ds-plaques div { padding: 18px 20px 20px; background: var(--walnut, #2a1f18); font-family: "Archivo", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ds-plaques dt { margin: 0; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--paper-on-walnut, #c9ad7f); } .ds-plaques dd { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ledger, #efe6d2); } .ds-plaques div:last-child dd { color: var(--brass-light, #d4b57a); font-size: 1.5rem; }

components.name: Sold chip
components.description: The empty cubby's marker: square, brass hairline at 50%, uppercase paper-on-walnut.
components.css: .ds-sold { display: inline-block; font-family: "Archivo", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--paper-on-walnut, #c9ad7f); border: 1px solid rgba(176,141,87,.5); border-radius: 0; padding: 6px 8px; background: var(--walnut-deep, #1c130e); }

narrative.overview:
Someone else runs the desk; you receive the statement. The page is a hotel front desk seen from the guest's side: a dark walnut counter, ledger paper laid on it, brass hardware for everything you can touch, and one green safe for the promise. The reader is a Northern-European professional in their fifties reading on a laptop in the evening. Nothing on the surface asks them to hurry, calculate, or scroll a dashboard. Chapters alternate between walnut (the desk) and ledger paper (the reading), so the eye rests on one of two grounds at any moment and is never asked to parse a third.

Density is editorial, not dense: one headline per chapter, prose at a 62-character measure, and numbers pulled out into brass numerals that read as engraved rather than charted. Motion is physical and short: a tag lifts off its hook, a split-flap cell turns, a settling tag swings like a pendulum. Nothing fades in for its own sake.

Confirmed visual rejections (from the direction contract, held in the build): no cream-serif-olive development-site look, no yield dashboard, no cards floating on drop shadows, no rounded corners, no colour other than brass on an action.
keyCharacteristics: Two grounds only: walnut desk chapters and ruled ledger-paper chapters, alternating.
Brass is the single action colour and the single money-numeral colour.
One hotel-green field, used exactly once, for the guarantee.
Archivo (variable width 62–125) for plates, labels, controls, captions, and every number; Libre Caslon Text for prose.
Zero radius everywhere; circles only for hardware (hooks, tag holes).
Depth is engraved (inset highlight top, inset shadow bottom), never floated.
Motion is physical, under half a second, and fully removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Brass Is Action Rule
rules.body: Brass appears on exactly two kinds of element: things you can press (plates, tags, tabs, arrows, input baselines, links) and money or unit numerals. A decorative element in brass is a violation; a clickable element in any other colour is a violation.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Hotel green is the guarantee chapter and nothing else. A second green field would make it a theme colour; its rarity is what makes it a safe.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: Every chapter sits on walnut or on ruled ledger paper. Text on walnut is ledger (primary) or paper-on-walnut (secondary); text on ledger is ink (primary) or ink-soft (secondary). No third ground, no white.

rules.name: The Plates-and-Book Rule
rules.body: If it is a label, a control, a caption, or a number, it is Archivo. If a person would read it as a sentence, it is Libre Caslon Text. A number set in Caslon or a paragraph set in Archivo is a violation.

rules.name: The Width-Not-Weight Rule
rules.body: Archivo hierarchy is carried on the width axis. Numerals are narrow (84–92), headlines are near-normal (96–100), plates and labels are wide (108–112). Weight stays at 500 for anything large and 600 for anything small and uppercase; nothing goes bolder.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every euro amount, percentage, and area figure is font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so columns of money line up on the ledger.

rules.name: The Engraved Rule
rules.body: Only brass lifts. A brass surface always carries the top highlight and bottom bevel; a wooden case is always recessed with an inset brass ring; paper never has a shadow. A floated card on a ledger chapter is a violation.

rules.name: The Press Rule
rules.body: Pressing a plate moves it 1px down and shortens its shadow; hovering moves it 1px up and lightens it. Nothing scales.

rules.name: The Square Hardware Rule
rules.body: If it is not a hook or a hole, it has no radius. Do not round a button, chip, image, or input "a little".

dos: Do put every action in brass and every money numeral in brass-light; keep both off everything else (The Brass Is Action Rule).
Do alternate walnut and ruled ledger chapters and pair text colour to ground: ledger/paper-on-walnut on walnut, ink/ink-soft on ledger (The Two Grounds Rule).

Do set labels, controls, captions, and numbers in Archivo and prose in Libre Caslon Text; carry Archivo hierarchy on the width axis, narrow for numerals (84–92) and wide for plates (108–112) (The Plates-and-Book, Width-Not-Weight Rules).
Do set every euro, percentage, and m² figure in tabular numerals and hold prose to 62ch.
Do engrave brass (top highlight, bottom bevel, short drop) and recess cases (inset brass ring); leave paper flat (The Engraved Rule).
Do keep motion physical and under 500ms on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), and remove all of it under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Do frame with the single fluid gutter and a 12-column chapter grid at ≥900px; stack below.
donts: Don't add a radius to anything that is not a hook or a hole (The Square Hardware Rule).
Don't use hotel green anywhere but the guarantee chapter (The One Green Rule).
Don't introduce a third ground (white, grey, a second paper tone) or float a card on a shadow over ledger paper.
Don't add a secondary or outlined button style; secondary actions are text links or the 48px arrow control.
Don't use a red for errors; the field error is terracotta (error-border / error-text) so it stays in the desk's temperature.
Don't set a number in Caslon or a paragraph in Archivo, and don't push Archivo above weight 600.
Don't add eyebrows or kickers above headlines; the build has none. Sub-lines sit under the headline in Title or paper-on-walnut body.
open: Brass tags, the guarantee plate, and plate buttons are CSS gradients plus an engraved shadow stack, not engraved-brass raster assets (user scope: skeleton first).
Hero aerial hero-riba-roja-drone.webp (and -alt) is a Higgsfield nano_banana_pro render with a provenance .webp.json; labelled 'illustrative aerial, generated' until a real drone shot replaces it.
Construction carousel has 7 photographs; the brief wants 10.
Form handoff channel undecided: desk.js HANDOFF.mode is 'whatsapp' with a 'mailto' alternative; hint and status copy switch with it.
Analytics not hooked on index-d.html, by user decision.
The '€113 / night' listing price is derived from the workbook (€2,200 ÷ (30 × 0.65)) and labelled illustrative.
Libre Caslon Text italic is not shipped; no italic is used on the page.
Declared but unused tokens --ledger-deep (#e3d6b8) and --green-deep (#173a2f) are left out of the frontmatter.
One-off values not tokenised: hero headline #fbf6ea and its text-shadow; safe prose #e7e0cf; .listing__price colour via !important.
